summary:
LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, WEEK 9 JUST DELIVERED AN ABSOLUTE SLOBBERKNOCKER, and we've got "THE GRANA SLAMMA" mjgrana dropping a NUCLEAR 180.04 points on poor Tishathefish like it was NOTHING! LETS GOOOOO! This man rolled out Christian McCaffrey for 31.8 points and JOE FLACCO – yes, ELITE DRAGON JOE FLACCO – for 30.7 points! Meanwhile, "THE PIZZA DELIVERY MAN" PrinceofPizza is out here serving up a 146.06-point BANGER with Brock Bowers going absolutely BONKERS for 37.3 points! That's a TE putting up WR1 numbers, FOR THE BRAND! Tee Higgins added 29.6 points because apparently this week we're just allowed to have nice things!

But HOLD ON A SECOND, we need to talk about the absolute CARNAGE that "THE SHOGUN ASSASSIN" laid down on powerperson with a 61.5-point beatdown! Drake London went for 34.3 points and Justin Herbert added 27.7 – that's 135.4 total points of PURE ELECTRICITY! And can we give it up for Seananigans dropping 47.32 points of pain on Langland? Jacoby Brissett with 24.8 points and Puka Nacua with 19.3 – THAT'S how you get it DONE! Though Langland, my guy, starting Luke McCaffrey and Ray Davis for a COMBINED ZERO POINTS is absolutely CRIMINAL! That's leaving your fantasy team out to dry like week-old pizza!

Now let's address the ELEPHANT IN THE ROOM – PrinceofPizza, brother, you WON by 31.76 points but you left SO MANY points on the bench that your lineup decisions look like they were made by someone ordering pizza at 3 AM! Rome Odunze with a GOOSE EGG and Bryce Young with 3.0 points? YIKES! And apparently you've got multiple bench players just BEGGING to get in the game! You won this week, but those decisions are gonna haunt you when the playoffs roll around, I'm telling you right now!

The tr4sh cold streak continues at FOUR WEEKS NOW, losing to cosmohouck by 12.36 points despite having Jayden Daniels and Justin Jefferson on the roster! Meanwhile, "THE COMEBACK KID" mastab24 is riding high with Geno Smith dropping 26.3 points – GENO SMITH, PEOPLE! – and taking down TophTT who's now trending DOWN faster than my golf handicap! The league average was 108.28 this week, and we had SIX managers above that line! This league is HEATING UP at exactly the right time, and I am HERE FOR IT! BOOM!
